label: What was expected, what printed and how gold reacted, release by release. Descriptive: not a forecast, not a tested edge.

CPI.name: CPI
prep: On 58 releases since 2022-01-12, gold moved a median ±0.78% on the day and closed up 52% of the time.
When Core CPI m/m came in higher than the month before, gold averaged +0.06% on the day (n 19); lower: +0.53% (n 18).
Not enough captured consensus yet to compare gold's reaction with the surprise: the council started capturing it in November 2026.

NFP.name: Jobs report
prep: On 56 releases since 2022-01-07, gold moved a median ±0.76% on the day and closed up 54% of the time.
When Payrolls (k) came in higher than the month before, gold averaged -0.07% on the day (n 26); lower: +0.1% (n 30).
Not enough captured consensus yet to compare gold's reaction with the surprise: the council started capturing it in November 2026.

FOMC.name: Fed decision
prep: On 39 releases since 2022-01-26, gold moved a median ±0.74% on the day and closed up 56% of the time.
When the Fed raised rates, gold averaged +0.67% on the day (n 12); when it cut: -0.28% (n 6).
Not enough captured consensus yet to compare gold's reaction with the surprise: the council started capturing it in November 2026.

sources: Expected: the economic-calendar consensus the council captured before the release (a calendar value, not a verified survey); for CPI 2022-24 the Cleveland Fed model (a model, not a consensus). Printed: the veteran batch's first prints 2022-24, else the current FRED value of the reference month (it can include revisions). Gold / dollar: the UTC release-day close vs the close before (council daily closes); first 5 / 60 minutes from council/event-base.json (HistData, to Oct 2026).
